# Load libraries

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(WGCNA)
library(DESeq2)
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
library(CorLevelPlot)
library(gridExtra)


```

# Prepare metadata

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# samples 
samples <- c(
  "X"
)

# 2) metadata
meta <- tibble(sample = samples) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      grepl("X", sample) ~ "X",
      grepl("Y", sample) ~ "Y",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),


    condition_chemical = case_when(
      grepl("X", sample) ~ "X",
      grepl("Y", sample) ~ "Y",
      grepl("Z", sample) ~ "Z",
      grepl("H", sample) ~ "H",
      grepl("L", sample) ~ "L",
      grepl("B", sample) ~ "B",
      grepl("D", sample) ~ "D",
      grepl("F", sample) ~ "F",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    condition_date = case_when(
      grepl("RNA_Seq_05-24", sample) ~ "05-24",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_12-24", sample) ~ "12-24",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_03-25", sample) ~ "03-25",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    condition_prep = case_when(
      grepl("K", sample) ~ "K",
      grepl("D", sample) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species),
    condition_chemical = factor(condition_chemical),
    condition_date = factor(condition_date),
    condition_prep = factor(condition_prep)
  )

# rownames как в DESeq2
meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
meta$sample <- NULL

meta

```

# Count data preprocessing

## read count data

```{r}
#fetch data
count_data <-fread("X.txt")

```

## prepare count data

```{r}

# gene ids
gene_id <- count_data$Geneid

# choose count columns
count_df <- as.data.frame(count_data[, 7:ncol(count_data)])  
rownames(count_df) <- gene_id

# making numeric
count_mat <- as.matrix(count_df)
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "numeric"

# clean sample names
count_samples <- colnames(count_mat)
count_samples <- sub("^X", "", count_samples)
count_samples <- sub("X", "", count_samples)
colnames(count_mat) <- count_samples

# matching counts and meta samples
meta_samples <- rownames(meta)
common <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), meta_samples)

cat("Samples in meta:", length(meta_samples), "\n")
cat("Samples in count_mat:", ncol(count_mat), "\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common), "\n")


count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta_sub <- meta[common, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub), rownames(meta_sub)))


```

# Quality control & outliers finding

## gSG and hierarchial clustering methods to detect the outliers

```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width=10}

#quality control

gsg<-goodSamplesGenes(t(count_mat_sub))
summary(gsg)
gsg$allOK

table(gsg$goodGenes)
table(gsg$goodSamples)

#repel genes that was detected as outliers
count_mat_sub<-count_mat_sub[gsg$goodGenes == TRUE,]

#hierarchial clustering 
short_labels <- with(meta_sub, paste(species, condition_date, condition_chemical, condition_prep, sep = "_"))

# check length
head(short_labels)

#find correlation and visualize it
x <- log2(as.matrix(count_mat_sub) + 1)
d <- as.dist(1 - cor(x, method = "pearson"))
outlier_clusters2 <- hclust(d, method = "average")

plot(outlier_clusters2, labels = short_labels, cex = 0.8, hang = -1,
     main = "Sample clustering (log2, 1 - cor)")

```

## pca method to detect the outliers

```{r,fig.height=6, fig.width=10}

#pca-method(compute principal "prcomp" companents for the expression data) to detect outliers 

X <- t(count_mat_sub)             # samples x genes
X <- log1p(X)                     # стабилизация
pca <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca.data <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca.var <- pca$sdev^2
pca.var.percent <- round(pca.var / sum(pca.var) * 100, 2)

ggplot(pca.data, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(pca.data)), vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1: ", pca.var.percent[1], "%"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", pca.var.percent[2], "%")
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

## outliers expel

```{r}
samples.to.be.excluded <- c(
    "Outlier_1",
  "Outlier_2"
)

# 1) remove sample from counts (genes x samples)
count_mat_sub_no_outliers <- count_mat_sub[, !(colnames(count_mat_sub) %in% samples.to.be.excluded), drop = FALSE]

# 2) remove sample from metadata (samples x traits) 
meta_sub_no_outliers <- meta_sub[!(rownames(meta_sub) %in% samples.to.be.excluded), , drop = FALSE]

# 3) sanity: same samples, same order
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub_no_outliers), rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers)))


if (!("X" %in% colnames(count_mat_sub_no_outliers))) {
  print("Y")
}

colnames(count_mat_sub_no_outliers)
```

## group samples accotding with their special affiliation

```{r}
#| label: define-human-vs-chimp-groups

cn <- colnames(count_mat_sub_no_outliers)

human_group <-
  grepl("X", cn)

chimpanzee_group <-
  grepl("Y", cn)
keep_by_name <- human_group | chimpanzee_group
samples_by_name <- cn[keep_by_name]

group_sub <- ifelse(human_group[keep_by_name],
                    "H_X",
                    "C_X")

group_sub <- factor(group_sub,
                    levels = c("H_X", "C_X"))

table(group_sub)
```

# Run DESeq2

```{r}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat_sub_no_outliers,
  colData   = meta_sub_no_outliers,
  design    = ~ condition_date + species
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("species", "H", "C"))
```

## filtering and normalizing DESeq results

```{r}

# filtr: >=15 reads min in 75% samples
dds50 <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 15) >= ceiling(ncol(dds) * 0.75), ]
nrow(dds50)

# normalization (VST)
dds_norm <- vst(dds50, blind = FALSE)

# get normalazing meanings
norm.counts <- t(assay(dds_norm))
```

# Estimating sft

```{r}
# making powers vector
power <- c(c(1:20), seq(from = 22, to = 50, by = 2))

#evaluate-scale-free-topology
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(norm.counts,
                  powerVector = power,
                  networkType = "signed",
                  verbose = 5)

#vizualization of evaluation
sft.data <- sft$fitIndices

```

## two plots visualizing sft meaning dependence from power

```{r}
#visualizing different powers
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(sft.data, aes(x = Power, y = SFT.R.sq, label = Power)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "purple") +
  labs(x = "Power",
       y = "Scale free topology model fit (signed R^2)") +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(sft.data, aes(x = Power, y = mean.k., label = Power)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, color = "pink") +
  labs(x = "Power", y = "Mean connectivity") +
  theme_classic()
```

# WGCNA

## building of network

```{r}
# make matrix numeric
norm.counts[] <- sapply(norm.counts, as.numeric)
#28 -21 modul
soft_power <- 28
temp_cor <- cor
cor <- WGCNA::cor

soft_power <- 28

blockwisenet <- blockwiseModules(
  norm.counts,
  maxBlockSize = 15000,
  TOMType = "signed",
  networkType = "signed",
  power = soft_power,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  numericLabels = FALSE,
  randomSeed = 1234,
  verbose = 3,
  corType = "pearson"
)

```

## moduls presence and eigengene escimating

```{r}
cor <- temp_cor

#Module Eigengene Infromation
module_eigengenes <- blockwisenet$MEs
head(module_eigengenes)

dim(module_eigengenes)
colnames(module_eigengenes)
```

## moduls significance

```{r}
library(limma)
# model design (биология + batch) 
design <- model.matrix(~ condition_date + species, data = meta_sub_no_outliers)

# matrix of modules: modules x samples ---
ME_mat <- t(module_eigengenes)

# check
stopifnot(nrow(design) == ncol(ME_mat))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(design), colnames(ME_mat)))

# limma model
fit <- lmFit(ME_mat, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# coefficient comparing Human vs Chimp
coef_name <- grep("^species", colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]
coef_name

# results table
me_stats <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")

# add module names 
me_stats$module <- rownames(me_stats)

# leave only important coulumns
me_stats <- me_stats[, c("module", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")]

# watch top
head(me_stats, 20)
```

## moduls filtering according with their significance

```{r}

sig_modules <- me_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)

sig_modules
```

## module–trait correlation analysis

```{r,fig.height=6, fig.width=10}

traits <- meta_sub_no_outliers

# convert factors to numeric
traits_num <- data.frame(lapply(traits, function(x) as.numeric(as.factor(x))))
rownames(traits_num) <- rownames(traits)

moduleTraitCor <- cor(module_eigengenes, traits_num, use = "p")

moduleTraitP <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples = nrow(norm.counts))

labeledHeatmap(
  Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
  xLabels = colnames(traits_num),
  yLabels = colnames(module_eigengenes),
  ySymbols = colnames(module_eigengenes),
  colorLabels = FALSE,
  colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
  textMatrix = signif(moduleTraitP, 2),
  main = "Module–trait relationships"
)

```

## module eigengenes by species

```{r,fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#| label: plot-selected-modules

ME_df <- as.data.frame(module_eigengenes)
ME_df$species <- meta_sub_no_outliers$species
ME_df$sample  <- rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers)

# only important modules
selected_colors <- c("black", "pink", "red")

available <- colnames(ME_df)

selected_modules <- unique(c(
  selected_colors[selected_colors %in% available],
  paste0("ME", selected_colors)[paste0("ME", selected_colors) %in% available]
))

if (length(selected_modules) == 0) {
  stop("Не найдено ни одного выбранного модуля в ME_df. Посмотри colnames(ME_df).")
}

plot_df <- ME_df %>%
  dplyr::select(species, dplyr::all_of(selected_modules)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(selected_modules),
    names_to = "module",
    values_to = "ME"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module = sub("^ME", "", module))

pal_species <- c("X" = "#1f77b4", "Y" = "#ff7f0e")

ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = species, y = ME, fill = species)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ module, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Selected module eigengenes by species",
    x = "",
    y = "Module eigengene (ME)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_species)
```

## HEATMAP

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
library(pheatmap)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

# 1) expression matrix for heatmaps
# norm.counts = samples x genes
# pheatmap needs genes x samples
mat <- t(norm.counts)   # genes x samples
mat_ens_base <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(mat))

# 2) only selected modules
sig_modules <- c("black", "pink", "red")
print(sig_modules)

# 3) annotation for samples
ann <- data.frame(
  species = meta_sub_no_outliers$species,
  donor   = meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_chemical,
  prep    = meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_prep,
  date    = meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date,
  row.names = rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers)
)

ann <- ann[colnames(mat), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(ann), colnames(mat)))

# 4) annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  species = c(
    X     = "black",
    Y = "#EDC948"
  ),
  prep = c(
    A = "#274C77",
    B = "#0B1F3A",
    none   = "#1F3A5F"
  ),
  date = c(
    "05-24" = "#D8A7B1",
    "12-24" = "#B07AA1",
    "03-25" = "#C992A4"
  ),
  donor = c(
    R    = "#9C755F",
    D   = "#4E342E",
    G    = "#D9C2A3",
    L    = "#B08968",
    K  = "#5D4037",
    O  = "#C4A484",
    M = "#EDC948",
    S = "#8D6E63"
  )
)

# 5) heatmap colors
hm_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2b6cb0", "white", "#c53030"))(101)

# 6) module colors from WGCNA
moduleColors_all <- blockwisenet$colors
stopifnot(!is.null(names(moduleColors_all)))

# keep common genes only
common_genes <- intersect(names(moduleColors_all), rownames(mat))
moduleColors_all <- moduleColors_all[common_genes]
mat <- mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(names(moduleColors_all), rownames(mat)))

# 7) plot heatmaps for selected modules only
for (module_color in sig_modules) {

  genes_in_module <- names(moduleColors_all)[moduleColors_all == module_color]

  if (length(genes_in_module) < 5) {
    message("Skip ", module_color, ": too few genes in module (", length(genes_in_module), ")")
    next
  }

  mat_m <- mat[genes_in_module, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(mat_m) < 5) {
    message("Skip ", module_color, ": too few genes found in matrix (", nrow(mat_m), ")")
    next
  }

  mod_ens_base <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(mat_m))

  symbols_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys      = unique(mod_ens_base),
    column    = "SYMBOL",
    keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  # top variable genes in module
  vars <- apply(mat_m, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  top_n <- min(20, length(vars))
  top_genes <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:top_n]
  mat_top <- mat_m[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # rename rows to symbols
  top_ens_base <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(mat_top))
  sym <- unname(symbols_map[top_ens_base])
  sym[is.na(sym) | sym == ""] <- top_ens_base[is.na(sym) | sym == ""]
  rownames(mat_top) <- make.unique(sym)

  # z-score by gene
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_top)))
  mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0

  # order columns by metadata
  ord <- order(ann$species, ann$date, ann$prep, ann$donor)
  mat_z_ord <- mat_z[, ord, drop = FALSE]
  ann_ord   <- ann[ord, , drop = FALSE]

  pheatmap(
    mat_z_ord,
    color = hm_colors,
    breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 102),
    annotation_col = ann_ord,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 10,
    border_color = NA,
    clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    clustering_method = "complete",
    treeheight_col = 25,
    treeheight_row = 25,
    main = paste0(module_color, " module — top variable genes (z-score)"),
    legend = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r}
#check GO of the most important modul
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# 1) module colors
module_colors <- blockwisenet$colors
names(module_colors) <- colnames(norm.counts)

# 2) genes in red module
red_genes <- names(module_colors)[module_colors == "red"]
red_ens <- sub("\\..*$", "", red_genes)

# 3) convert red genes to ENTREZ
entrez_red <- bitr(
  red_ens,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# 4) background universe = all genes used in WGCNA
all_genes <- names(module_colors)
all_ens <- sub("\\..*$", "", all_genes)

universe_df <- bitr(
  all_ens,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# 5) GO enrichment
ego_red <- enrichGO(
  gene = unique(entrez_red$ENTREZID),
  universe = unique(universe_df$ENTREZID),
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

# 6) show results
head(as.data.frame(ego_red), 10)
```
